one_line_contribution: A 2x2 provenance crossover in ALFWorld in which a retrieved procedural-experience bank and a GEPA-optimized instruction are each labelled by which three ALFWorld task types' episodes produced them, so that 'how much of the bank's task-specific value an optimized instruction has already absorbed' is read off the instruction-provenance x bank-provenance interaction (Delta_abs), with a headroom correction fitted along an information-free best-of-w sampling ladder.
closest_prior_work: EvoAgentBench (arXiv 2607.05202) and MIPROv2 (arXiv 2406.11695) jointly. EvoAgentBench already puts a retriever (ReasoningBank, +3.6) and GEPA (+1.2) on the same 528/267 training trajectories across four domains and three backbones, which is exactly the proposal's qualitative headline -- an optimizer given the same episodes gets roughly what the bank gets -- and the proposal concedes this in Related Work section 3 ('already in the literature; we cite it as motivation rather than claiming it'). MIPROv2's instruction-only vs demonstration-only vs joint ablation is the two-container question itself, with the finding that the split is task-dependent, which pre-empts the qualitative answer. Neither is a full collision: EvoAgentBench has no combined optimizer-plus-memory cell and no provenance manipulation, and MIPROv2 has no retrieval. But together they leave the residual novelty as a design device (the provenance labelling) whose primitive the proposal itself declines to claim, plus one environment's measurement. A reviewer will ask what the interaction buys beyond a table that is already published, and the answer is a second-order statistic with SE 1.85pt.
strongest_objection: The identification rests entirely on the ladder correction, and the ladder under-corrects in the direction of the hypothesis, so Delta_abs > 5pt is reachable with zero content transfer between containers. Inner(I) = acc(I x B_own) - acc(I x B_oth) does hold the residual unsolved set constant within one instruction, but Delta_abs compares Inner at I_own against Inner at I_oth and repairs the level gap with Inner_H fitted on ladder A (cell 10, best-of-w action sampling, w in {2,4,8}). Best-of-w raises accuracy by resolving games lost to sampling noise; an on-type optimized instruction raises accuracy by resolving games lost to missing type-specific procedure -- precisely the games the on-type bank is there to fix. So at matched no-memory accuracy the ladder leaves the type-specific-fixable games unsolved while I_own has already removed them, Inner_H(l_own) stays high while Inner(I_own) collapses, and the difference is scored as absorption. The residual-unsolved-set objection that the proposal says 'cannot be raised against' its endpoint has not been eliminated; it has been moved out of the primary contrast and into the correction term, where it is confounded with the effect rather than orthogonal to it. Ladder B (step budget, cell 11) does not test this: it is a second generic knob, and generic-vs-generic agreement is uninformative about generic-vs-targeted mismatch. Compounding this, Delta_abs is not the claim in the title. A large Delta_abs says the *type-specific* slice of the bank's value shrinks; the practitioner-relevant assertion that 'the bank stops paying at an optimized instruction' is g(I_own, B_own), which is demoted to secondary endpoint (c)/prediction 5 with a +/-1.5-1.9pt bounded-loss CI. The paper's headline therefore rests on a secondary quantity while the confirmatory endpoint is an interaction that does not entail it.
what_would_fix_it: (1) Add the arm that separates episode provenance from task-type provenance: an instruction I_own' optimized on a P_train-disjoint pool of the *same* three task types, evaluated against B_own and B_oth. If Inner(I_own') is as depressed as Inner(I_own), the effect is 'the instruction learned the task type', not 'the instruction absorbed these episodes', and the 'same training episodes, two containers' framing that the title asserts is dead. As written, P_train is shared by both containers by design, so the square cannot make this distinction at all. (2) Fix the partition or measure it first. T_A = {pick_two, clean, look_in_light} and T_B = {pick_and_place, cool, heat} split the near-isomorphic pairs across sets: clean/cool/heat are the same find-object -> apply-appliance -> place skeleton, and pick_two/pick_and_place differ by a repetition. The partition was chosen by game counts, which maximizes cross-type transfer and therefore minimizes the relevance advantage G3 needs. Worse, G1 (g(I0,B_own) >= 5pt) and G3 (g_own - g_oth >= 4pt) together require the off-type bank to be worth <= 1pt in an environment where all six types share one action space and one receptacle-search procedure. Measure cross-type transfer on S_dev before committing, or partition by procedural similarity ({pick_and_place, pick_two, look_in_light} vs {clean, cool, heat}). Otherwise the modal outcome is the G3 branch, whose primary is the level-ladder endpoint the proposal says four rounds of reviewers already rejected. (3) Replace or supplement ladder A with a *targeted* level control -- e.g. instructions produced by subsampling the on-type optimizer's rollout budget, giving a level ladder that moves accuracy the same way the treatment does -- and pre-register a sensitivity analysis stating how much of Delta_abs survives if the correction under-corrects by a stated fraction. (4) Promote g(I_own, B_own) to co-primary. (5) Discharge pre-freeze obligation (2) before submission, not before freeze. (6) Republish the call budget: ~15 calls/episode is inconsistent with G0's own 20-60% timeout rate at L0 in 20-30 (timeouts always spend the full budget), and ladder A's w in {2,4,8} cells cost roughly 3.75x their episode count in calls, so the 54-76h Tier 0 figure is understated by roughly 2-3x.
missing_baseline: The disjoint-episode, same-type instruction: I optimized on a pool of the same three task types that is disjoint from the pool used to distil B_own, run against B_own and B_oth (four cells at n=500 would do). This is the only arm that distinguishes 'the instruction absorbed the content of these specific episodes' from 'the instruction learned this task type's procedure from any episodes', and the container-substitution framing -- one training pool, two containers -- is exactly the thing it tests. A second, cheap omission: a hand-written type-specific instruction (a person given the task-type list, not the episodes) as the control for whether the optimizer is doing anything the type label alone does not, which matters because prediction 2 already asserts a large type-specific component.
preprint_collision: The check is far above the norm for a proposal in process -- dated re-scan (2026-09-03 vs 2026-08-21), 15 queries over 244 papers, by-id verification of 54 IDs, a committed scan table with a stated no-additions rule, one competitor PDF read in full with its extracted text SHA256-committed, and a self-correction of a web snippet that misreported ReasoningBank's Qwen gain as +7 against the PDF's +3.6. It is not a rubber stamp: it withdraws a v2 novelty sentence and reinstates five wrongly retracted citations. But the state it reports is 'novelty not yet established', which is a weakness, not a neutral. Three obligations are explicitly undischarged, and they are the load-bearing ones: (2) the search for held-out-episode/data-provenance crossovers in the prompt-optimization, contamination and data-attribution literatures has *never been run*, and it bears on the single primitive the residual novelty rests on -- the proposal concedes that if it lands, the contribution 'reduces to the ALFWorld measurement, the on-policy control and the compiled-block comparison', which is a workshop paper; (1) the appendix of arXiv 2608.14036 is unopened and is named as the collision that would gut prediction 6, so one of eight falsifiable predictions is knowingly at risk of pre-emption; (3) the ALFWorld/embodied cross-task-type transfer literature has not been searched, and cross-type transfer of procedural memory is the most likely place the type-set manipulation already exists under another name -- it is also the literature that would tell the authors in advance whether G3 can pass. Verification is single-channel for everything except EvoAgentBench: arXiv is unreachable from the node, so the remaining ~25 IDs are confirmed through web-search snippets, the exact channel that already produced one documented factual error, and 'confirmed absent from the paper' claims (no token matching, no combined condition) are asserted from abstracts for every competitor but one. I cannot name a preprint that already makes this exact claim, and the closest one the authors did find (EvoAgentBench 2607.05202) they have correctly characterized as pre-empting the headline but not the interaction. The honest summary is that the novelty claim is conditional on searches that should have been run before the proposal was submitted for review, and reviewers will treat 'we claim no novelty for the primitive and have not looked' as an unresolved risk rather than as candor credit.
